intended_object: An internal helper. It writes one coordinate (indexed by a barred permutation c) of the refined Fox–Neuwirth realization chart for a top cell q as a linear functional on barycentric coordinate vectors. It exists so that `refinedChart_coordinate_eq_linear` and the barycentric-combination lemmas can be proved. This reading comes from the docstring and how the definition is used in the module.
explanation: The definition composes two library-specific linear maps: `realizationCoordinateLinear` for the top representative of q, and `affineCompLinear` for the refinement permutations. The result packages one coordinate of a particular chart as a `LinearMap`. It is used right afterwards, in `refinedChart_coordinate_eq_linear` and in proving that the chart preserves barycentric combinations. It belongs to the bookkeeping of the proof formalization for Nandakumar–Ramana Rao (Fox–Neuwirth subdivision cells) and is not a standard mathematical notion, so it has no literature counterpart to compare with.
